name: Adani Enterprises Ltd.
business_summary: Adani group's incubator holding: Integrated Resources Management (coal trading, Carmichael and Indonesian mining, MDO mining services), airports through Adani Airport Holdings (Mumbai, Navi Mumbai opened Oct 2025, six other airports), Kutch Copper smelter (80.6 kt sold in Q2), roads, water, data centres (AdaniConneX JV), solar/wind manufacturing, green hydrogen, defence and PVC. Q2 FY27: total income Rs38,023 cr (+74%), EBITDA Rs6,316 cr (+62%), H1 EBITDA Rs11,958 cr (+56%), attributable profit Rs1,492 cr (-55%; screener NP Rs1,221 cr) on higher interest and depreciation. Raising ~US$1 bn at AAHL (US$18 bn pre-money). CARE AA/Stable. Mcap Rs3.70 lakh cr, P/E 115. Segment shares in revenue_mix are model estimates. Seed tier says NIFTY_50 (brief called it Next 50): treated at Next-50 depth.

exposures.mechanism: Adani Airport Holdings (AAHL: Mumbai, Navi Mumbai and six other airports - list per model knowledge) contributes Rs1,641 cr = 26% of Q2 EBITDA (income Rs3,786 cr, +20%; EBITDA +55%). Primary equity raised at US$18 bn pre-money (Sep 2026) = ~Rs1.7 lakh cr, about 46% of ADANIENT's Rs3.70 lakh cr mcap. +10% traffic => ~+9% airport revenue/EBITDA (aero+non-aero, operating leverage) => ~+9% on 46% of value = +4%; x0.8 persistence for capex dilution => +3.2; trimmed to +3.0. Depreciation from Navi Mumbai caps profit conversion.

evidence.note: AAHL raising ~US$1 bn (Rs9,825 cr) from Alpha Wave, Premji Invest, Temasek, BlackRock funds at US$18 bn pre-money for 5.54%

exposures.mechanism: Escalation lifts ATF/Brent (US$95; peak ~US$117 on 30 Oct), closes Gulf airspace (international pax ~25% of airport traffic, model estimate), raises LNG/shipping costs and drives risk-off in a stock with beta 1.5. Offsets: coal and copper trading margins sometimes widen. Net -1.5 per +1 escalation step.

evidence.note: Hormuz tanker attacks and Gulf strikes push Brent to six-month high (event catalogue)

exposures.mechanism: Empirical -0.63 per +10% Brent (t=-0.9, beta 1.38): ATF costs reduce airline capacity growth, higher diesel raises mining services costs; direct mechanisms small. Weight at empirical value.

Integrated Resources Management (coal trading, Carmichael/Bunyu mining, mining services) is a large volume business (~Rs-denominated trading margin per tonne) whose EBITDA benefits from higher prices through Carmichael and Indonesian mines and inventory gains but loses on volume if buyers shift. Assume coal-linked ~25% of EBITDA: +15% price => +10% on that segment net of pass-through => +2.5% EBITDA x1.25 x0.5 => +1.5; shaded to +1.0. Seaborne thermal coal is flat since June (US$96). Not significant in the pack (t<1).

evidence.note: IRM/mining services part of Q2 mix (details not extracted)
India coal crunch raises imported-coal demand (catalogue EV_INDIA_COAL_CRUNCH)

exposures.mechanism: Kutch Copper smelter (1 Mtpa): Q2 copper sales 80.6 kt vs 11.8 kt a year ago; copper EBITDA reported Rs2,033 cr (period unclear: Q2 or H1). Earnings are processing margin (TC/RC at record lows per Fastmarkets, which hurts) plus by-products (sulphuric acid, gold, silver) and inventory gains; flat-price sensitivity is modest: +10% copper => ~+3% on copper EBITDA via inventory/by-product => +1.2 after ramp-up. Copper at record in Sep, +28% y/y.

evidence.note: Copper sales volume 80,600 t vs 11,800 t

exposures.mechanism: Foreign-currency borrowings (AEL and AAHL USD bonds; Australian mining) and imported copper concentrate/coal outweigh USD earnings; Kutch copper cathodes are sold domestically at LME-linked INR prices (neutral). Assumed ~25% of debt unhedged USD: +3% x 25% x Rs90,000 cr debt = Rs675 cr mark-to-market/interest ~ -4% of EBITDA x persistence 0.3 => -1. Uncertain: hedge ratio not found.

P/E 115 and ROCE 5.8% on TTM: valuation rests on long-dated airport, data-centre, copper and green-hydrogen earnings, i.e. very long duration. +25 bp on cost of equity at an implied duration of ~15-20 years => -2.5 to -4%; central -2.5. 10y G-sec ~7.4% after RBI's hike and liquidity drain.

Interest expense Rs2,296 cr/q (Rs9,200 cr/yr) against H1 EBITDA Rs11,958 cr; ~30% floating-linked: +25 bp on ~Rs27,000 cr = Rs68 cr = 0.4% of annual EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.25 => -0.5; ~-0.4 after capitalised interest. CARE upgraded the rating to AA/Stable on 7 Oct 2026.

evidence.note: CARE Ratings upgrades Adani Enterprises to AA/Stable

exposures.mechanism: Heavy refinancing/new-debt needs for capex (airports, copper phase 2, data centres, solar) at ~8-9%; +50 bp on ~Rs50,000 cr to refinance/raise in 12 months = Rs250 cr = -1.4% of EBITDA; plus access/sentiment (Adani paper has historically repriced sharply in credit stress). Net -1.5.

evidence.note: Rating upgrade cut credit-spread sensitivity; stock still fell 4% that day

exposures.mechanism: Index heavyweight (Nifty 50) with FII 10.7% and DII 10.6% after Sep-quarter changes; high-beta (1.54). +US$5 bn quarterly FPI inflow => +2.0; record CY2026 outflow (~Rs3 lakh cr) has been a drag; FPI turn-positive odds 0.55 by Jan 2027.

AdaniConneX (JV with EdgeConneX) is a large option in the SOTP; +1 (stronger Indian data-centre build-out) => +1.5 via valuation; AI capex pause (Oct 2026 AI sell-off, EV_AI_CAPEX_RESET_RISK odds 0.28) is the risk.

Solar module/cell/wafer manufacturing (Mundra), wind turbines and green hydrogen sit in Adani New Industries; ALMM List-II cell mandate in force since 1 Jun 2026 (approved cell capacity 37.8 GW) and Rs14,500 cr BESS VGF (4 Nov) support integrated domestic makers. +1 (stronger support) => +1.5.

evidence.note: ALMM List-II domestic cell mandate in force

exposures.mechanism: Roads (BOT/HAM), water, railway/mining-service orders and airport/city-side development depend on public capex; +10% growth => +1.2. Union Budget 1 Feb 2027 capex push odds 0.7.
Duties on Chinese solar cells/glass/aluminium frames and PVC protect Mundra solar and PVC; DGTR wave Sep-Oct 2026. +1 => +0.8.
